recent.text: Bummed for Aday Mara dealing with the shin contusion. He’s been excellent in an unexpectedly much bigger role. Real impact on both sides of the court. OKC has missed him the last couple of games. First Team All Rookie is possible, he’s been that good. Hope he’s back soon.

recent.text: Obviously the long term injuries are OKC's biggest issue. But compounding those injuries with also missing Alex Caruso, Aday Mara and JWill right now (and Ajay for a couple games/SGA last night) makes every game tough. Especially on the road. 6-1 at home 4-7 away
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Isaiah Hartenstein has been great in the 2nd half. OKC's only healthy big has 18 points and 9 rebounds. Thunder down 105-106. 6 minutes to go.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Thunder down 91-96 after 3 quarters. Fought back down from 13 points. OKC playing well on offense. But tough to get stops without Chet, JDub, Wallace, Caruso, Mara and JWill. Gotta survive the 4th quarter SGA bench minutes. Keep it close then hope the MVP can close it out.
recent.author: Brandon Rahbar

recent.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has 30+ points for the 11th time this season. Tied with Luka Doncic for most in the NBA.
